m02_latency_minus1.description: DIVIDE ends at step 21 (22 divide steps, done one cycle early, wrong value)

m03_ties_toward_zero.description: exact ties (2R == L) round toward zero for both signs

m04_neg_ties_up.description: negative exact ties round toward +inf (half up in signed terms)

m05_neg_off_by_one.description: negative results use ~q + s instead of ~q + !s (off by -1)

m07_start_restarts.description: a start while busy restarts the datapath (busy-ignore dropped for the datapath)

m08_shift_beats_done.description: a shift in the completion cycle overrides the new result

m09_shift_rotates.description: shift rotates result[11] into bit 0 instead of zero fill

m10_reset_keeps_result.description: synchronous reset does not clear result

m11_reset_keeps_done.description: synchronous reset does not clear done (done holds through reset)

m12_reset_no_abort.description: reset does not abort a running division (state only reset when idle)

m13_latch_always.description: LATCH_DENOMINATOR=1 samples the denominator every cycle (behaves like 0)

m14_remainder_not_cleared.description: remainder is not cleared at load (holds its old value through IDLE)
